source: Mullikin's Auto Body not-included operations catalogue (from the Flask-EST_EMS project); edit freely. Terms are case-insensitive substrings matched against every line description and operation on the estimate.

rules.title: Pre-repair scan (if applicable)
rules.why: Pre-repair DTC documentation before disassembly is commonly required on many vehicles.

rules.title: Post-repair scan + clear/verify DTCs
rules.why: Post-repair scan documents successful repair and verifies no new faults remain.

rules.title: Battery support / power maintainer (as needed)
rules.why: Voltage stability prevents module faults during scan/calibration/programming.

rules.title: Baseline health check / quick code check (if no formal scan line)
rules.why: If no scan line exists, consider documenting at least a baseline code check where appropriate.

rules.title: Attach scan reports (pre/post) / print-to-file
rules.why: Scan reports improve payment success and are good documentation.

rules.title: Module programming / setup (if module replaced/updated)
rules.why: Many modules require setup/programming after replacement.

rules.title: Module relearn / initialization (if required)
rules.why: Relearn/initialization procedures may be required after certain R&I or replacements.

rules.title: Immobilizer / key relearn (if applicable)
rules.why: Some vehicles require key/immobilizer pairing after battery/module events.

rules.title: Battery recharge / test (if needed)
rules.why: Battery stabilization/recharge may be needed during extended key-on diagnostics.

rules.title: Reset electronic memory functions after battery disconnect
rules.why: Memory resets are commonly required after battery disconnect events.

rules.title: ESD / electronics handling precautions (if servicing modules/sensors)
rules.why: Electronic modules/sensors are sensitive to voltage fluctuations and ESD.

rules.title: Clear codes + re-check after repairs (if applicable)
rules.why: Clearing/confirming DTCs ensures no latent faults remain.

rules.title: Disable SRS system (if working near airbags/sensors)
rules.why: SRS disable steps may be required beyond simple battery disconnect depending on OEM.

rules.title: SRS/airbag system scan + post-repair verification
rules.why: If SRS components are disturbed, document scan/verification post-repair.

rules.title: Seat belt inspection / replacement decision (if crash severity warrants)
rules.why: Some OEMs recommend belt component inspection/replacement after occupant loading.

rules.title: Occupant classification/seat sensor calibration (if applicable)
rules.why: Seat sensors/OCS may require calibration after seat/SRS events.

rules.title: Airbag module reset/replace procedure (if deployed)
rules.why: Airbag module often requires reset procedures or replacement after deployment.

rules.title: Steering column inspection (binding/length/deformation)
rules.why: Collapsible columns should be inspected after significant impacts.

rules.title: Disable high voltage system (hybrid/EV) if applicable
rules.why: Hybrid/EV repairs often require HV disable steps and PPE.

rules.title: Verify airbag components are not refinished
rules.why: Airbag components should not be refinished; confirm estimate doesn’t include refinish on SRS parts.

rules.title: Wheel alignment check (and alignment if needed)
rules.why: Front-end structural/suspension disturbance should trigger alignment verification.

rules.title: Steering angle sensor reset / relearn (if equipped)
rules.why: After alignment or steering/suspension work, some vehicles require SAS relearn.

rules.title: Yaw rate / zero-point calibration (if equipped)
rules.why: Some stability systems require zero-point calibrations after alignment/repairs.

rules.title: Ride height calibration (air suspension/level sensors) if equipped
rules.why: Ride height/level sensors may require calibration after suspension/height changes.

rules.title: Torque-to-spec suspension/steering fasteners (document if performed)
rules.why: Many repairs require torque-to-spec documentation (esp. suspension/steering components).

rules.title: Auto headlamp leveling calibration (if equipped)
rules.why: Vehicles with auto-leveling headlamps may require calibration after front end work.

rules.title: Aim headlamps (if applicable)
rules.why: Lamp aiming is commonly not included with headlamp replacement operations.

rules.title: Fog lamp aim / verify beam pattern (if applicable)
rules.why: Fog lamp replacement can require aim/position verification.

rules.title: Headlamp function check / cycle test (if applicable)
rules.why: After lamp/actuator work, verify full functional operation.

rules.title: Lamp wiring/connector check (if lamp removed/replaced)
rules.why: Lamp R&I often requires checking connectors/pigtails for damage and proper routing.

rules.title: Forward radar calibration / aiming (if equipped)
rules.why: Bumper/grille removal can disturb radar alignment; OEM may require recalibration.

rules.title: Front camera calibration (if equipped)
rules.why: Camera systems often require calibration after structural/bumper/windshield events.

rules.title: Rear camera calibration / functional check (if equipped)
rules.why: Rear camera systems may require aiming/verification after rear repairs or camera R&I.

rules.title: 360/surround view calibration (if equipped)
rules.why: Multi-camera surround systems often require calibration after camera/bumper repairs.

rules.title: Park assist sensor learn / calibration (if equipped)
rules.why: Park sensors in bumper covers may need initialization/verification after R&I/refinish.

rules.title: Park sensor retainer/mount kit (often non-reusable) if applicable
rules.why: Sensor retainers/mounts often break or are one-time-use; add if required.

rules.title: Blind spot monitor calibration/verification (if equipped)
rules.why: Quarter/bumper R&I can affect BSM sensor alignment; verification may be required.

rules.title: Adaptive cruise (ACC) calibration/aim (if equipped)
rules.why: ACC radar/sensor aiming may be required after front structure/bumper work.

rules.title: Windshield camera calibration (if equipped)
rules.why: Windshield replacement or R&I may require camera calibration.

rules.title: Structural measurement (pre-repair) / datum verification
rules.why: If rail/apron/core support involvement exists, pre-measure helps blueprint and justify repairs.

rules.title: Structural measurement (post-repair) / printout
rules.why: Post-measure documents vehicle returned to spec after structural operations.

rules.title: Frame/bench setup time (if used)
rules.why: Setup varies by equipment and is commonly not included; add based on on-the-spot evaluation.

rules.title: Pull setup / anchoring / tie-down time (if used)
rules.why: Anchoring and setting pulls is real time and often not captured.

rules.title: Clamping/holding fixtures setup (if required)
rules.why: Fixtures/clamps/holding tools setup can be needed for sectioning/welding fit-up.

rules.title: Structural fit-up / test-fit / gap checks
rules.why: Test-fitting panels/structure before weld/bond reduces comebacks; often missed on sheet.

rules.title: Sectioning setup / cut line layout (if sectioning performed)
rules.why: Layout/measure/cut steps are real labor when sectioning panels.

rules.title: Weld test coupon / destructive test (if required)
rules.why: Some OEM/I-CAR procedures call for test welds when welding certain substrates.

rules.title: STRSW/squeeze-type resistance welding setup (if used)
rules.why: Electrode setup/fit and validation may be required; not always included.

rules.title: Rivet/bond setup + consumables (if used)
rules.why: Rivet/bond operations involve specific prep, tooling and consumables beyond base times.

rules.title: Weld-through primer application (if welding performed)
rules.why: Weld-through primer is required on bare metal mating surfaces before welding per OEM/I-CAR.

rules.title: Corrosion protection / cavity wax / seam sealer (as required)
rules.why: Corrosion protection restores factory protection on repaired/replaced panels.
